name: UTokyo Research Internship Program (UTRIP)
host: University of Tokyo, School of Science
amount: One-time GSS-UTRIP scholarship (airfare + daily costs, varies by region) + free housing; FUTI Award up to $2,000 for US-enrolled students
fields: Natural sciences (physics, chemistry, biology, earth science, astronomy, maths)
note: Summer lab research at UTokyo's School of Science (about 6 weeks) with no programme or housing fees. Priority to third-year students of a four-year degree; results early April 2027.

name: UTokyo Amgen Scholars Program
amount: Airfare, accommodation and living allowance covered

eligibility.note: Undergraduates enrolled at a bachelor's-granting institution in Asia, after at least their first year and not graduating before the programme

fields: Life sciences, chemistry and related sciences
note: Eight-week summer research internship, 3 Jun – 30 Jul 2027, plus the Amgen Scholars Asia Symposium in Kyoto (3–5 Aug). Apply via the TAO online system; results mid-to-late March 2027.

name: Kyoto University Amgen Scholars Program
amount: Scholarship (¥180,000 in 2026) plus programme-covered travel and housing; check official page for 2027

eligibility.note: Undergraduates at universities in Asia (Amgen Scholars Asia); master's and doctoral students not eligible

fields: Life sciences, chemistry and related sciences
note: Summer research at Kyoto University, 4 Jun – 5 Aug 2027, for about 10 students. Shortlisted applicants (mid-Feb) submit a short video; results late March 2027.

name: KAUST Visiting Student Research Program (VSRP)
host: King Abdullah Univ. of Science & Tech.
note: Fully funded research internship with a KAUST faculty member, typically 2–6 months. Current PhD students, KAUST students and KAUST alumni cannot apply.

name: Kupcinet-Getz International Summer Program
amount: US$1,100 stipend + flight subsidy up to US$400 + free housing

eligibility.note: International bachelor's or master's students (not PhD) after their first year, or recent bachelor's graduates continuing in academia

fields: Physics, chemistry, life sciences, maths, computer science
note: Eight-week research programme in a Weizmann lab, 16 Jun – 12 Aug 2027. No application or tuition fees; housing in nearby dormitories.

name: Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award (SIPGA)
note: Funds 2–6 month research attachments at A*STAR research institutes in Singapore. Contact a prospective A*STAR supervisor before applying; enquiries to sipga_office@hq.a-star.edu.sg.

name: KAI-X Summer Research Internship Program
amount: ~₩2,100,000 (2026: airfare up to ₩1M, dorm up to ₩500k, ₩600k living)

eligibility.note: Undergraduates (3rd/4th year) and master's students enrolled at universities outside Korea; PhD students excluded

fields: Physics, chemistry, maths, biology, brain & cognitive science, medical science
note: Seven-week summer lab internship (1 Jul – mid-Aug in 2026). Date estimated from 2026 cycle, whose window closed in Feb 2026; 2027 call not yet announced.

name: MBZUAI Global Research Internship Program (MGRIP)
host: Mohamed bin Zayed Univ. of AI
amount: Stipend (amount not stated) + accommodation, airfare, visa, health insurance, airport transfers

eligibility.note: Students in the penultimate year of a STEM bachelor's or master's degree, finishing after September 2027

fields: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, NLP, robotics
note: Fully funded four-week AI research residency in Abu Dhabi, 7 Jun – 2 Jul 2027 (formerly UGRIP). Projects released in November; decisions by 2 Apr 2027.

name: Westlake University Summer Research Internship
amount: RMB 1,760 living allowance (2026) + free on-campus housing; no programme fees
dlText: ~31 Mar 2027, 23:59 Beijing time, estimated from 2026 cycle

eligibility.note: International students currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a bachelor's or master's programme

fields: Life sciences, physics, chemistry, engineering, AI and other Westlake research areas
note: One-month lab internship in Hangzhou (13 Jul – 14 Aug in 2026) with application, programme and housing fees waived. Interns pay their own visa, insurance and travel; 2027 call not yet out.

name: Westlake International Research Exchange (WIRE)

eligibility.note: International STEM students; check official page for degree-level requirements

note: Research exchange of 1–6 months in a Westlake lab with a monthly living stipend. Applicants should demonstrate English proficiency.

name: Taiwan International Internship Program (TIIP)
amount: NTD 30,000/month (before tax) + half of economy airfare, up to NTD 15,000

eligibility.note: Final-year undergraduates, master's students and BSc/MSc holders; PhD students and past TIIP participants excluded

fields: Life, physical, chemical, computational and other sciences at Academia Sinica institutes
note: Summer research internship (cohorts May–August) at Academia Sinica, Taipei. Airfare support is reimbursed only after successful completion.

name: Internship and Research Immersion in Singapore (IRIS@NUS)
host: NUS Graduate School, National University of Singapore
amount: SGD 1,200/month + SGD 600 travel allowance + free on-campus housing
dlText: Several rounds a year; next window opens end Dec 2026

eligibility.note: Full-time undergraduates (2+ years completed) or master's students at universities other than NUS

fields: Science, engineering, computing and other NUS research areas
note: Fully funded 2–3 month research immersion at NUS; apply via the GDA3 portal as a non-degree full-time applicant. The round for the January 2027 intake closed 28 Aug 2026.

name: NUS SoC Summer Research Internship
host: National University of Singapore, School of Computing
amount: SGD 500/week for 10 weeks (housing at own cost)
dlText: ~16 Jan 2027, estimated from 2026 cycle (time not stated)

eligibility.note: Current undergraduate or master's students, graduates within one year, and early-career faculty without a PhD

note: Ten-week summer research internship with NUS Computing faculty. Interns must find their own housing; acceptances in late February.

name: MBI Undergraduate Summer Training Programme (MUST)
host: Mechanobiology Institute, National University of Singapore
amount: S$600 stipend for 6 weeks + accommodation (international interns)
dlText: ~31 Jan 2027, estimated from 2026 cycle (time not stated)

eligibility.note: Undergraduates; stipend and accommodation are for international interns

note: Six-week summer lab internship at MBI; international interns receive a stipend and accommodation. 2027 call not yet announced.

name: NTU Global Connect Fellowship
amount: SGD 5,000 total (SGD 2,000 settling-in + SGD 1,500/month) + free on-campus housing + tuition waiver

eligibility.note: Final-year bachelor's or master's students at overseas universities graduating in 2027 or 2028

note: Two-month summer research at NTU, 1 Jul – 31 Aug 2027 (successor to India Connect@NTU). No minimum GPA or English test stated; selection on merit.

name: HKU Summer Research Programme
host: The University of Hong Kong, Graduate School
amount: HK$10,000 scholarship + airfare up to HK$5,000 + accommodation up to HK$5,000 (2026, reimbursed on completion)

eligibility.note: Students interested in research postgraduate study at HKU; check official page for year-of-study rules

note: Summer research attachment for prospective MPhil/PhD applicants; support paid on completion. 2026 applications ran 9 Jan – 9 Feb 2026.

name: REU at the Einstein Institute of Mathematics
amount: ~US$250/week stipend + dormitory housing (no airfare or insurance)
dlText: Review from ~15 Feb 2027, estimated from 2026 cycle; later applications welcome

eligibility.note: Undergraduate mathematics students; check official page for nationality rules

note: Summer research experience for undergraduates (1 Jun – 30 Jul in 2026) in Jerusalem. Airfare and health insurance are not covered.
